descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it’s dyed with pure color all the way through so there’s no white core. * 24 sheets * 8-1/2" x 11" * Pumpkin Pie * Acid free * Lignin free

images.description: A bright golden-yellow or marigold colored cardstock or paper product displayed as a single rectangular sheet against a light neutral background. The product appears to be a standard letter or card-size sheet with clean edges and a subtle shadow effect suggesting dimension.
